probe.notApplicable: doc_repo control, no customer surface; proven by violation in a real git repo, a linked worktree and a merge (git-commit-gates.mjs --self-test)

missionPremise: The doc_repo close gates ran only as Claude Code tool hooks keyed on P:/doc_repo as the working directory, so no lane close committed in a seat worktree, or landed by merge, was ever graded (teardown T9 item 5; A-183).
completionPredicate: A violating close is refused at git pre-commit in the main checkout and in a linked worktree, and at pre-merge-commit when a branch carrying one is merged; a conforming close commits; each refusal leaves a record; an uninstalled hooks path is refused at the next integration commit.
built: scripts/enforcement/git-commit-gates.mjs (install, check, hook runner, end-to-end self-test)
.claude/hooks/probe-close-gate.mjs (refuses doc_repo commits while core.hooksPath is not installed)
scripts/enforcement/probe-close-gate.mjs (self-test now runs only when the file is the entry point)
installed: core.hooksPath = P:/doc_repo/.githooks in the shared git config, read back from P:/seat-worktrees/dispatch-planner/doc_repo at 2026-09-16.

evidence.gitCommitGatesSelfTest: 9 of 9: no-close commit passes; depth-0 close declaring sub-agents refused at pre-commit; OPS-24 close with neither artifact nor notApplicable refused; conforming close commits; same violating close refused in a linked worktree; --no-verify lets it through (the named bypass); merge carrying the violating close refused at pre-merge-commit; four refusal records written; both modes named.
evidence.installCheckByViolation: Before install the Claude Code hook returned block (exit 2) with the install instruction and --check exited 1; after install --check exited 0 and the hook exited 0.
evidence.otherSuites: probe-close-gate self-test all passed; fan-depth-gate self-test 16 of 16; hooks-loadable PASS (13 hooks) on three runs. One earlier run inside a combined shell command printed a Node crash tail that did not recur and was not captured in full.

falsifier: The pre-registered failure: a violating close committing in a linked worktree, or a merge carrying one completing. Neither happened in the self-test; both were refused with the gate's message.
contradicted: The self-test first ran the wrong suite: probe-close-gate.mjs ran its own self-test whenever any process carried --self-test, so importing it exited before this suite started. Fixed with an entry-point guard.
bypasses: git commit --no-verify and git merge --no-verify (no record)
fast-forward merges create no commit; the commits they bring were gated where they were made
a clone or a machine that has not run --install; the Claude Code hook catches it only in Claude Code sessions committing to P:/doc_repo
a node that cannot start refuses every commit rather than passing it

leave_behind.item: the four lanes dispatched 2026-09-16 (P-252, P-249, P-284, P-248/P-261) now meet this gate when they commit their closes; a refusal is the gate working, not a lane defect
probe-close-gate allows probe.notApplicable for any OPS-24 row, while OPS-24 law 1 says read-only reviews only; build lanes use it with status closed-partial
